title: cloto-connector.json v1
description: Connector manifest v1. The contract a connector repository publishes so ClotoHub.dev and ClotoCore can sync, validate, install, and seal it without per-connector special-casing. The reference implementation is `mgp-sdk` (Rust, in the `mgp-rs` workspace); this schema and `mgp-sdk::types::ConnectorManifest` are kept in lock-step.

spec_version.description: Manifest schema version. Must equal 1 for v1.

id.description: Stable connector identifier (kebab-case, ASCII lowercase / digits / hyphen; no leading or trailing hyphen).

category.description: Marketplace category. Open vocabulary for v1.

trust_level.description: MGP §2.3 trust tier. The catalog layer enforces seal absence -> `untrusted` (MGP 0.6.3-draft Security Invariant 3).

magic_seal.description: MGP §8 L0 Magic Seal in `sha256:HEX` form (64 lowercase hex chars). Required at registration.

icon.description: Optional UI icon (URL or short identifier).

host_compatibility.description: Hosts that can run this connector (e.g. `clotocore`, `claude-code`, `claude-desktop`, `cursor`, `project-airi`). Empty array means unspecified, not 'no hosts'.

env_vars.description: Required environment variables. Hosts MUST refuse to start the connector when any of these are missing.

optional_env_vars.description: Optional environment variables. Hosts MAY pass them through when set; missing values do not block startup.

auto_restart.description: Whether the host should automatically restart the connector on unexpected exit.

changelog.description: Optional CHANGELOG content (Markdown). Catalog UIs MAY render this on a connector detail page.

package_manager.description: Package manager used to materialize the connector. v1 only accepts `uv`.

dependencies.description: Extra dependencies the host should resolve in addition to the source's own lockfile.

directory.description: Subdirectory inside the source tree where the connector lives. Empty string means root.

bin_name.description: Binary name produced by the build. Used when `runtime` is `rust`. Ignored otherwise.

SourceSpec.description: Source descriptor. `type` (snake_case) selects the variant; the remaining fields are flattened into the inner spec.

SourceGit.description: Git repository, optionally pinned to a ref.

url.description: Clone URL (http(s) or scp-style ssh, e.g. `git@github.com:owner/repo.git`).

reference.description: Branch / tag / commit SHA. Empty string means upstream default branch (resolved at fetch time).

subdir.description: Optional subdirectory inside the cloned tree where the manifest applies. Mirrors `install.directory` for consumers that need the source-side hint.

SourceRawUrl.description: Raw HTTP(S) artifact (typically a tarball or zip).

url.description: Direct download URL. Scheme MUST be `http` or `https`.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the artifact (64 hex chars). Optional but strongly recommended; required for assets the consumer cannot re-derive (binary releases, frozen tarballs).

SourcePypi.description: PyPI package. Consumer materializes via `uv pip install <package>[==<version>]`.

package.description: Package name as it appears on PyPI. Non-empty, no whitespace.

version.description: Optional PEP 440 version pin. Empty / null allows latest.

SourceDocker.description: Docker image reference. Consumer materializes via `docker pull` (or any OCI-compatible client).

image.description: Image name. Includes registry host and namespace if non-default (e.g. `ghcr.io/cloto-dev/foo`); short form (e.g. `nginx`) resolves against Docker Hub. Non-empty, no whitespace.

tag.description: Tag or digest. Empty / null falls back to `latest`. Catalog SHOULD reject `latest` for production registration.

name.description: Variable name. Spec-level canonical key. SDK implementations MAY accept legacy field names (e.g. `key`) as a deserialization alias for migration from pre-v1 registries; producers MUST emit `name` going forward.

default.description: Default value the host SHOULD inject when the operator has not provided one. Hosts MUST still treat the variable as 'set' for downstream contracts when defaulted. Null or omitted means no default; missing values then fall through to host policy (= refuse-to-start for `env_vars`, pass-through-when-set for `optional_env_vars`).
